title: Workflow editor panel + AppRightPanels integration
description: Create WorkflowEditorPanel.tsx with form-based workflow editor (step list + detail editor), execution controls, and inline checkpoint UI. Register in AppRightPanels.tsx as lazy-loaded panel.
action: Create src/components/panels/WorkflowEditorPanel.tsx with workflow list view, step editor form, execution panel with step progress, and inline checkpoint review (approve/modify/reject buttons). Add 'workflow-editor' to RightPanelType union in AppRightPanels.tsx with lazy loading.

criteria: Component renders workflow list from store.workflows
Step editor form with fields: name, agentMode (dropdown), prompt (textarea), inputSource (dropdown), checkpoint (dropdown), enabled (toggle)
Execution panel shows current step progress with stepResults
Checkpoint UI shows approve/modify/reject buttons when activeExecution.status === 'paused'
WorkflowEditorPanel is lazy-loaded via React.lazy in AppRightPanels.tsx
convergence.verification: npx tsc --noEmit exits 0; panel renders without runtime errors
convergence.definition_of_done: Workflow editor panel provides full CRUD UI for workflows and step-by-step execution with checkpoint controls

files.change: New panel component with workflow list, step editor, execution controls, checkpoint UI
Add 'workflow-editor' to RightPanelType union, add lazy-loaded WorkflowEditorPanel to panel map

implementation: Import workflow store actions from useAppStore (fetchWorkflows, saveWorkflow, deleteWorkflow, startExecution, executeNextStep, approveStep, rejectStep)
Import Workflow, WorkflowStep, AgentMode, InputSource, CheckpointType from types
Build three sub-views with tab or section layout: Workflow List, Step Editor, Execution View
Workflow List: map store.workflows with name + step count, click to select, create new button, delete button (disabled for builtin-)
Step Editor: show steps[] of selected workflow as reorderable list, click step to edit detail form, add/remove step buttons

Step form fields: name (input), agentMode (select: writing/analysis/evaluation/custom), prompt (textarea), inputSource (select: previous_step/chapter_content/story_bible/outline), checkpoint (select: none/review/approve), enabled (checkbox)
Execution View: when activeExecution exists, show step progress list with status indicators, current step highlighted, completed steps show truncated output
Checkpoint UI: when activeExecution.status === 'paused', show last step output in a readonly textarea with approve, modify (with editable textarea), and reject buttons
Use existing UI components from the project (Button, Input, Select, Textarea patterns from AutomationPanel.tsx)
In AppRightPanels.tsx: add 'workflow-editor' to RightPanelType union type
In AppRightPanels.tsx: add WorkflowEditorPanel = React.lazy(() => import('./panels/WorkflowEditorPanel')) and map to 'workflow-editor' key

success_metrics: All store actions wired to UI controls

reference.pattern: Follow AutomationPanel.tsx for panel structure and UI component usage. Follow AnalysisPanel.tsx for store-connected panel pattern.

rationale.chosen_approach: Form-based step editor (not node-based) matches existing panel patterns and keeps complexity low for V1
decision_factors: Form-based editor lower complexity than visual node editor
Inline checkpoint UI keeps workflow interaction in one panel
rationale.tradeoffs: No visual node-based editor in V1 — deferred per analysis

risks: UI complexity is highest in this task — may need to simplify initial implementation
